explanation: Fires only at D1 (always 0 at GO and D2), and only when the previous trial was a2 reaching S2 by the common route late in the episode (trial 80 or later); it is 10 if that trial was rewarded and part of a run of rewarded a2-to-S2 trials, about 6-7 if it was unrewarded right after such a run, and 0 after a rare transition, after any a1 choice, or after an unrewarded trial with no recent reward run. In the same situation earlier in the episode it is weaker: around 2-3 near trials 50-60, and 0 before about trial 50.
